notes.title: Demo Available Now on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The demo of [b]Hmph! Hmph! Yowai[/b] is now available on the Steam page. Do give it a try!

If you find any bugs or have suggestions, feel free to share them via the [b]Steam Discussions forum[/b].

Please consider adding the game to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] if you like the demo. And don't forget to share it with your friends. Your support will be greatly appreciated!

Thanks!
~ [b]Kevin[/b]
